title: Platform Module Entitlement Matrix — Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
The travel-management platform behind the Corporate Travel Programmes is sold in modules, and each tier carries a fixed set of them. This matrix publishes, tier by tier, whether the travel policy engine enforces the company's rules at the point of booking, how many levels of approval the workflow supports before a booking is released, and whether duty of care, live traveller tracking, destination risk alerts, programmatic access to the booking platform, single sign-on against the company's own directory and automatic delivery of booking data into the company's expense system are included in the subscription.

| Programme tier | Policy engine | Approval levels | Duty of care | Traveller tracking | Risk alerts | Programmatic access | Single sign-on | Expense integration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | Not included | 0 | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Business Team Programme | Included | 1 | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Business Pro Programme | Included | 2 | Included | Not included | Included | Not included | Included | Included |
| Business Enterprise Programme | Included | 3 | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | Included | 4 | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Business Global Programme | Included | 6 | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included | Included |

The approval column counts the levels of approval the workflow supports before a booking is released; 0 on the Business Starter Programme is the published figure for that tier and not an omission. The approval levels do not rise by one at every step: they run 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and then 6, so the Business Global Programme carries two more levels than the Business Enterprise Plus Programme.

Reading the matrix by column rather than by row: the policy engine first appears on the Business Team Programme, duty of care, risk alerts, single sign-on and expense integration on the Business Pro Programme, and traveller tracking together with programmatic access only on the Business Enterprise Programme. The Business Pro Programme is therefore the only tier that carries risk alerts while traveller tracking is not included.
